newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UBS strengthens Forex team in Asia.
newsitem.headline: UBS strengthens Forex team in Asia.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) has enhanced its foreign exchange business in the Asian time zone in a move aimed at strengthening its position in Asia, the company said in a statement.
Richard Silver, currently Global Head of Currency Derivatives, has moved from New York to Singapore to take up the post of Regional Manager for all foreign exchange activities in the Asian time zone.
He will retain his existing global responsibilities for currency derivatives as part of UBS's drive to integrate forex cash and derivative products, the bank said.
Anthony Ngai, currently Treasurer in Hong Kong, has been appointed Deputy Regional Manager for Forex in Asia, and Ken Lee has been appointed Head of Foreign Exchange Tokyo.
Ken Lee's appointment, given his background in derivatives marketing and structured products, is aimed at improving UBS's derivative capabilities, the bank said.
In other moves, UBS will enhance its derivatives service to Tokyo customers while Wang Kie will move from Hong Kong to Singapore as head of G7 Spot Trading.
